name: Reisha Trulyworth
original_name: 聆紗・トゥルーリーワース
source:
Likes: Her daughters, singing, cooking
Dislikes: Funboons, the Grand Bell

Luca's mother. She lives with [url=/c3688]Luca[/url] in Mint Block. She runs farms in Mint Block and makes a living with her daughter. She lost her other daughter and Luca's sister, Leyka, during an I.P.D. outbreak, and her husband, Batz, died trying to protect Leyka. 
She and Luca have been living together ever since, but when Luca revealed to be a Reyvateil at the age of 9, their relationship has been bad. Now, they hardly ever communicate at home, and even if Luca talks to her, she can only give her cold responses.

[From [url=http://www.nisamerica.com/games/AT2/]official site[/url]]
